title: The Frequency Shift — EN/JA/ZH (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 98bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers sparse percussion cosmic frequency modulation language learning EN JA ZH
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Something moved in the signal, something changed in the wave
The frequency is shifting from the world that I once gave
A modulation drifting through the spectrum of the night
The frequency is shifting — moving out of sight

[Verse 2 — Japanese, with English translation]
周波数がずれていく、静かに音が変わる
[The frequency drifts, the sound quietly changes]
古い信号は消えて、新しい波が来る
[The old signal fades, new waves arrive]
私は耳を傾けて、変化を聞いている
[I listen carefully, hearing the shift]
周波数の変化は、時間の流れに似ている
[The frequency shift resembles the flow of time]

[Chorus — English]
Frequency shift, moving through the night
From one dimension bleeding to the next
Frequency shift, everything in flight
A signal that has changed but not been hexed

[Bridge — Chinese Mandarin, with English translation]
频率在移动，像云在空中漂浮
[The frequency shifts, like clouds drifting in the sky]
旧的波形消逝，新的声音诞生
[Old waveforms fade away, new sounds are born]
在变化中有美丽，在转移中有意义
[In change there is beauty, in shifting there is meaning]
频率告诉我们，万物皆在流动
[The frequency tells us, all things are in flow]

[Outro — All three languages]
Frequency shift… 周波数シフト… 频率转移
Everything changes — すべては変わる — 万物皆变
That's my boy
